key_insight: LEAP learns a differentiable action over complete trajectories, creating a reusable objective for scientific inference and control.
engineering_relevance: A single learned action can support path ranking, mechanism steering, constrained optimization and sampling without learning a separate objective for each task.
method: Anchor the unknown stochastic action to a tractable reference process.
Learn an action correction by comparing observed and reference trajectories.
Capture local dynamics and nonadditive dependencies across time.
evidence_signal: Evaluations span stochastic physical systems, many-body orbital dynamics and molecular simulations, with reported recovery of dynamics and transfer across inference objectives and physical conditions.
watch_item: The abstract does not quantify accuracy or computational cost, leaving practical scalability and reference-process sensitivity unclear.
